title: fix(metadata-protocol): revertCommit answers only what it achieved, and a revert is revertible
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb95Ry8VZcsDAGqnUZRpB34e)_

Fixes #33563
Fixes #33564
Fixes #33486

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:撤销一次 AI 提交(revertCommit)时,行已写回但注册表/存储/投影没跟上的条目改报失败并写明行的状态;撤销提交记下它覆盖掉的版本,所以「撤销这次撤销」能真的恢复;整包回滚的注释改成如实说明撤销记录是尽力而为。
- 为什么改:原来这些情况一律报 success:true,和方法自己的契约「success 即运行中的进程已生效」以及 ADR-0067 D3「撤销本身可撤销」相反,操作员以为撤销成功了,实际进程没生效、或再撤销什么都没恢复。
- 风险与回滚:原来报 success 的少数撤销现在报 success:false 并列出失败条目(行已写回,只是如实上报);旧版本写下的撤销提交再被撤销时会点名失败、什么都不写。回滚即 revert 本 PR 六个提交。
- 先看:`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-package-commits.ts` 的 revertCommit(settle、replacedVersion、无版本条目分支),再看 `protocol.revert-commit-honest-outcome.test.ts`,最后 `protocol.ts` 两段注释。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol exec vitest run src/protocol.revert-commit-honest-outcome.test.ts`,预期 10 个用例全绿(含撤销再撤销把 'Renamed' 恢复回来)。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

One commit per card, then three test and ledger follow-ups.

1. **#33563** (`f1bf9b77`). In `revertCommit`, every item now records `rowWritten` once its row write lands. A step after that write which does not land is collected per item: the runtime registry refusing the restored object (the write-through's returned refusal, with its client-facing text and code), the storage sync refused (the `object-storage-sync-refused` advisory stays on `advisories`), or the mutation projector answering `{ success: false }` (its driver text is not quoted). Such an item goes into `failed[]`, not `reverted[]`, naming the row state ("its row was restored to the body of version N" or "its row was removed from sys_metadata"). A throw after the row write gets the same prefix in the `catch`. The revert's own commit is now built from the rows the walk changed (`revertPlan`), not from `reverted[]`, so a row that changed under a failed item is still recorded. `rollbackToPackageCommit` carries each such item through its existing per-item channel and answers `success: false`.
2. **#33564** (`7dccd175`). Before each row write, the revert reads the committing package's active row version (the same address `publishPackageDrafts` reads for its own plan) and records it as the item's `prevVersion`, with `existedBefore` true exactly when the row was there. Reverting a revert therefore restores the body the revert replaced, and an item the revert removed is written again. An item recorded with `existedBefore: true` and no `prevVersion` (the shape every revert commit an earlier release recorded) is named in `failed[]` with nothing written, and points at the item's own version history. It is no longer skipped.
3. **#33486** (`bfb561ff`). The `rollbackToPackageCommit` docblock says each step attempts its revert commit, best effort, and that `revertCommitId` is then omitted. It also names the post-row-write faults a step's `failed[]` now carries.
4. `1c566dfb`: `protocol.revert-stored-type-canonical.test.ts` pinned the revert plan's `prevVersion: null`, the value #33564 fixes. It now pins `2`. It is a separate commit because this branch is not force-pushable.
5. `863bd4b8`: the engine double in `packages/objectql/src/protocol-commit-history.test.ts` gains `syncObjectSchema`. Without that door, the double read as a refused storage sync, which now fails the item. This is a test-double gap, not a behaviour pin, and the edit was approved by the seat.
6. `e546a942`: `scripts/engine-double-contract.pinned.json` gains three additive rows for the new test file's `findOne`, `update` and `delete` doubles. This is the ledger `check:engine-double-contract --write` generates, committed with the seat's approval.

No spec schema moves: `failed[].code` is already optional and free-form, no new error code is coined, and the response keeps its declared keys. The two `protocol.ts` docblock paragraphs ship in the `.d.ts`, so the changeset is a `patch`.

**Pins this PR flips on purpose.**
- `packages/objectql/src/stored-expression-backfill.test.ts` ("a revert whose storage sync is refused writes no row, and says so per field"): the item is now in `failed[]` with its row named, and the advisory assertions are unchanged. The reason is the revertCommit docblock: "a revert that answers `success: true` is one the running process has already acted on". Edited with the seat's approval.
- `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.revert-stored-type-canonical.test.ts`: `prevVersion` null to 2, as above.

## Tests

`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.revert-commit-honest-outcome.test.ts` (new, 10 cases) runs on a stub engine under the real `SysMetadataRepository`, with a commit store that keeps every commit the protocol records.

- §1 #33563: a clean-restore control; the registry refusal, where the row is restored, `code` is `NAMESPACE_CONFLICT` and the revert commit still lists the item; storage refused; the projector failing on each limb; a throw after the row write; a rollback carrying the fault.
- §2 #33564: revert-of-revert on the restore limb (`prevVersion: 2`, and 'Renamed' comes back); revert-of-revert on the soft-remove limb (`prevVersion: 1`, and the row is written again); the legacy `existedBefore` item with no version (`failed[]`, and nothing written).

Ablations (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, each landed and then restored to `blob == HEAD`; vitest compiles `src`, so no rebuild is involved). A6 is run at the #33564 commit, the others where listed.

| Ablation | Red | Green |
| --- | --- | --- |
| A1: `settle` always pushes `reverted[]` | 5 (registry, storage, projector restore, projector remove, rollback) | 2 (control, throw-after-write) |
| A2: catch prefix off | 1 (throw-after-write) | 6 |
| A3: registry refusal not read | 2 (registry, rollback) | 5 |
| A4: restore-limb `prevVersion` back to null | 1 (restore revert-of-revert) | 9 |
| A5: soft-remove plan back to `existedBefore: false, prevVersion: null` | 1 (soft-remove revert-of-revert) | 9 |
| A6: no-version guard off | 1 (legacy item) | 9 |

A1 was predicted at 6 red and came out at 5: the throw case is carried by the `catch` prefix, which A2 covers alone.

## Acceptance notes

- Not seen by the revert, and not changed here (seat ruling: a loose end, not this PR): `applyRegistryWriteThrough`'s non-object branches and `restoreArtifactRegistryView`'s heal catch their own faults and only log them, inside `protocol-registry-hydration.ts`. That helper is shared with the save and publish doors. So a `view` or `permission` write-through fault is still invisible to `revertCommit`.
- The 2026-11-14 ADR-0067 amendment ("What the doors do") describes the code before this PR (revert plans carry `prevVersion: null`, and post-row faults stay out of `failed[]`). `docs/adr/**` is out of bounds for this PR, so a status-line amendment is owed after merge.

## Verification

Readings, local, on this box:

- Package suites at `d1480af6`/`1c566dfb`: `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` (350 files, 22892 passed); `@objectstack/objectql` (597 files, 13114 of 13115 passed; the one red was the double fixed in `863bd4b8`, which is green alone, 32/32); `@objectstack/rest` (417 files, 8742 passed); `@objectstack/runtime` (607 files, 12229 passed).
- After the last merge of `main` (`340d02d8`), with the closure rebuilt: every metadata-protocol revert test (24 files, 432 tests) and the four objectql revert/commit files (113 tests) are green.
- `pnpm lint` exits 0. `typecheck` for objectql and metadata-protocol exits 0.
- `dispatch-gates --ran`: all 81 derived families are accounted for. 80 exit 0. 1 is NOT MEASURED: `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exits 3 because it needs the whole workspace built, so it is left to CI.
- Dogfood: not run. The title has no `!` and Clause-② has no (narrowing) arm.

- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes.
- [x] 4. One branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request. Three cards are folded by the seat's order, one commit each.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: not applicable.
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English (the 维护者速读 block is Chinese by the repository's convention).
